name: Studio Soft Smile (A-pose and head default, female)
expression: a relaxed, warm, softly alluring smile - lips gently parted with at most a hint of the upper teeth (never a broad or toothy smile), the corners of the mouth lifted just enough to show soft smile creases and faint dimples, cheeks only slightly raised and the eyes kept wide open (no squint), chin very slightly lowered, brows relaxed, eyes warm and engaged with the camera (replace the source photo's expression entirely)
notes: Copy of studio-glamour (same chin, brows and gaze) with an open, soft smile: parted lips and lifted corners are what make a diffusion model draw a visible smile; 'closed-mouth smile' reads as neutral and 'sultry' as a pout with heavy lids. The negatives hold the smile small. Default for the female A-pose and head via SLOT_DEFAULTS in gen_prompt.py.
